discovery: The theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators and the quantum spin Hall effect
rationale: Topological insulators are a mature, heavily cited condensed-matter breakthrough. They build on the 2016 prize for topological phases and pair a clear theoretical prediction (Kane-Mele, 2005) with an experimental confirmation (Molenkamp's HgTe quantum wells, 2007). They have also already won the major precursor prizes (Breakthrough, Dirac, Oliver Buckley), which makes them a long-standing Nobel favorite.
